body: I feel a strong pull towards the tree, as if it's calling to me. As I approach, I notice that the surveyor's tape seems to be wrapped around different parts of the tree, creating a pattern of circular segments. I think to myself that the tape might be used to mark the tree's diameter for some kind of measurement or survey.
